$comment: U8 — notepad-scoped hooks. Arms ONLY in notepad sessions; Claude Code MERGES this with the user-level agent-notepad read-hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact/Stop). The PreToolUse(Bash) commit gate intercepts each `git [ -C <code-repo> ] commit` and applies the df-context-store staleness check (DESIGN §7.6): it governs AGENT code-commits, not manual human commits (arm the code repo's own git pre-commit hook for those). Runtime path convention per DESIGN §15: the installer (U10) copies hooks to the STABLE path ~/.claude/hooks/agent-notepad/ (NOT the branch-fragile repo path). Bypass a single commit with `--no-verify`; disable the gate for a session with AGENT_NOTEPAD_COMMIT_GATE=off.
